newsitem.title: LATVIA: Leading Latvian brick firm back in profit in '96.
newsitem.headline: Leading Latvian brick firm back in profit in '96.

text.p: Leading Latvian brick maker and key stock market share Lode Brick said on Friday that it returned to profit in 1996 after two years of losses.
Company president Janis Slesers said that the profit after tax in 1996 was an unaudited 130,000 lats and turnover was two million lats. He was also optimistic on 1997.
Lode made a 2,113 lats loss in 1995 after a 43,000 lat loss in 1994. Lode is one of the most active shares on the Latvian stock exchange secondary list.
"This year looks very hopeful with turnover already up 1.9 times or 91 percent by February 19," Slesers told Reuters.
"We see more building activity in 1997, especially in Latvia," he added.
Lode is currently quoted at 2.07 lats per share against an initial 67 santimes last autumn.
